headline: Recommended parking plan changes for Mission Boathouse and accepted construction management plan for 119 Rantoul Street
summary: The Commission discussed a modification to parking requirements at 1 Water Street (Mission Boathouse) after residents reported ongoing employee parking issues on Front Street. It recommended changes to the site plan conditions with several data and enforcement requirements attached. The Commission also reviewed and accepted a Construction Management Plan for 119 Rantoul Street with minor edits, and approved the October 7, 2025 meeting minutes.
decisions: Recommended modifying Site Plan Review #143-19 and Special Permit #173-19 for 1 Water Street to remove the employee shuttle requirement in favor of a dedicated parking area at 60 Water Street, subject to listed conditions; motion carried 7-0.
Accepted the Traffic Management Plan for 119 Rantoul Street with minor edits, to be resubmitted; motion carried 6-0.
Approved the October 7, 2025 meeting minutes as presented; motion carried 6-0.
